test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following words were added to the Preamble in the 42nd amendment of the Indian constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Socialist**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act 1976** brought about significant changes and additions to the Constitution, including the insertion of fundamental duties and the extension of emergency provisions.
 
• It ​is termed as "**Mini Constitution**".
 
• The **preamble **was **amended **by the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act in 1976**, in which three new words **Socialist**, **Secular**, and **Integrity **were **added**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Preamble **is called the introduction letter of the Indian Constitution.

 
 
• The preamble can be referred to as the preface which highlights the entire Constitution.
 
• It was adopted on 26 November 1949 by the Constituent Assembly and came into effect on 26 January 1950, celebrated as the Republic day in India.
 
 
 
• Important changes by 42nd Amendment of Indian Constitution 1976:

 
 

 Part of change
 Details
 
 

 Preamble
 'Sovereign Democratic Republic' was replaced by “Sovereign

 Socialist Secular Democratic Republic” and 'unity of the Nation' was replaced by “unity and

 integrity of the Nation”.
 
 

 Article 51A was added
 Introduced 10 fundamental duties of citizens.
 
 

 Judicial Powers of the High Court
 Reduced the judiciary review power of high courts.
 
 

 DPSPs (Directive Principles of State Policies)
 
 
Three new DPSPs (Directive Principles of State Policy) were added and one was amended:

 
1. Article 39 - To secure opportunities for the healthy development of children.

 
2. Article 39 A - To promote equal justice and to provide free legal aid to the poor.

 3. Article 43 A - To take steps to secure the participation of workers in the management of industries.

 4. Article 48 A - To protect and improve the environment and to safeguard forests and wildlife.
